units.source_text: 这时我仿佛看见她笑了。

en.t: At that moment, I seemed to see her smile.

units.source_text: 我仿佛看见她那洁白的门齿在月光下的闪光。

en.t: I seemed to see the gleam of her white front teeth in the moonlight.

units.source_text: 关于她的脸的变形，我不可能有更多的记述。

en.t: As for the distortion of her face, I could not possibly describe it any further.

units.source_text: 因为有为子站起来时，她的脸避开了明晃晃的月光，掩藏在小树林的阴影中。

en.t: For when Uiko stood up, her face turned away from the bright moonlight and was hidden in the shadows of the small grove.
